newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket jumped to $18.81 last week, from $17.6.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket jumped to $18.81 last week, from $17.6.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes rose strongly to $18.81 last week from $17.64 in the first week of May, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Tuesday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to May 15, has averaged $19.63 a barrel.
In April the basket price averaged $17.46, down from $18.64 in March and from $20.48 in February, it said.
For the first quarter of 1997, the basket price averaged $20.77 a barrel, against $23.06 in the fourth quarter of last year.
For 1996 as a whole, the price of the basket average $20.29, compared with $16.86 the previous year.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
